subject: Git/Codex development adapter v0.4
coverage: concurrent commit-event ingestion preserves every event
rapid linear commits coalesce into one source-bound receipt
unchanged declared inputs reuse accepted results
unchanged queued proof is not queued again and late accepted evidence satisfies the same input digest
human evidence requires explicit human authority
a critical failed check blocks its required delivery checkpoint
multiple agents can satisfy quorum and conflicts require explicit supersession
runtime state inside the product repository is refused
v0.4 schemas and example adapter load
limits: The run used temporary fixture repositories, not a production product repository.
No Hey Minie source, hook, checkpoint, build, device, TestFlight, merge, release, or remote state was changed.
Codex check execution is queued and attributed through the receipt contract; automatic Codex task dispatch is outside this increment.
